mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for material procurement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for material procurement varies significantly based on the complexity and uniqueness of your outdoor luxury project. Standard materials might have shorter lead times, while custom-fabricated elements, imported stones, or specialized fixtures can require several weeks to months for sourcing and delivery. We establish a detailed procurement schedule early in the planning process, factoring in these lead times to align with the overall construction timeline and minimize on-site delays.
